Name: Pre-Existing Relationship Redux
Author: tbonehunter
AuthorLabel: tbonehunter based on code from SpaceChase0
Description:
Preexisting Relationship Redux lets you start the game already married to an NPC.

This is a substantial rewrite of[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8989] Preexisting Relationship[/url] by [url=https://github.com/spacechase0]spacechase0[/url] originally released under the MIT License. Rewritten for Stardew Valley 1.6+ by tbonehunter. Spacechase0 has kindly authorized release of the rewrite.



Changes from original Preexisting Relationship: 

* Rewritten and renamed from *Preexisting Relationship* to *Preexisting Relationship Redux*.
* Updated for Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0+.
* Removed SpaceCore / SpaceShared dependency — now fully standalone.
* Rewrote marriage selection menu using vanilla game UI components.
* Fixed deprecated API calls (`Game1.getFarmer`, house upgrade methods, etc.).

Use

Start a new save (or load an unmarried save), and when the day starts you'll see a menu asking who you're married to. You'll start with the first house upgrade (so they have their spouse room), and heart events will still trigger like usual.

You can also type `marry` in the SMAPI console to reopen the menu at any time (if unmarried).

Compatibility

Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.

Works with some mods that add datable NPCs (including NPCMarriageable).
